actions.name: SRG uses IT-themed social engineering calls targeting law firms
actions.description: The cyber threat actor Silent Ransom Group (SRG) uses information technology (IT) themed social engineering calls to target law firms.

actions.name: SRG sends an individual posing as IT support to the firm in-person
actions.description: SRG sends an individual posing as an IT support employee to the firm in-person after the social engineering call.

actions.name: SRG inserts a storage device into a computer to steal sensitive data
actions.description: After sending an individual posing as IT support, SRG inserts a storage device into a computer to steal sensitive data for extortion.

actions.name: SRG uses callback phishing emails masquerading as subscription services
actions.description: SRG sends callback phishing emails masquerading as well-known businesses offering subscription plans, charging small amounts to avoid suspicion.

actions.name: SRG instructs victims to call to cancel fake subscription and sends remote access software link
actions.description: Victims are instructed to call the threat actor to cancel the fake subscription, who then emails a link to download remote access software.

actions.name: SRG establishes persistent access on victim device
actions.description: After the victim downloads remote access software, SRG establishes persistent access on the victim's device or system.

actions.name: SRG identifies valuable information to exfiltrate
actions.description: After establishing persistent access, SRG seeks to identify valuable information to exfiltrate.

actions.name: SRG exfiltrates data using WinSCP or hidden/renamed Rclone
actions.description: SRG exfiltrates data through WinSCP (Windows Secure Copy) or a hidden or renamed version of Rclone.

actions.name: SRG uses WinSCP portable to exfiltrate data if no administrative privileges
actions.description: If the compromised device does not have administrative privileges, SRG uses WinSCP portable to exfiltrate victim data.

actions.name: SRG sends ransom email threatening to share victim data if ransom not paid
actions.description: After exfiltrating data, SRG sends a ransom email threatening to share the victim’s data if a ransom is not paid.

actions.name: SRG calls employees at victim company to pressure ransom negotiations
actions.description: SRG calls employees at a victim company to pressure them into engaging in ransom negotiations.

actions.name: SRG maintains a publicly available site to post victim data
actions.description: SRG has developed a publicly available site to post victim data but is inconsistent in its use and does not always follow through on posting victim data.
